name: spell.disintegrate.name
editNote: Accepted: the book prints Defense 'AC and basic Fortitude' (p.325) -- an initial spell attack roll against AC, then a basic Fortitude save on a hit. The schema's defense field is oneOf 'ac' or {save,basic}, not both, so it can't hold the attack-roll half; the converter keeps the save half ({save:fortitude,basic:true}), which is what a defender actually rolls, and the attack-roll step is fully preserved in the spell's own text ('Make a spell attack against the target... with a basic Fortitude save'). Nothing is lost from the rules as printed, only from the structured metadata.
